riddle: लाल गाय पाथर खाए, पाणि पिबे तो मरी जाए।
roman: Laal gaay paathar khaaye, paani pibe to mari jaaye.
english_translation: A red cow that eats stones (wood), but if it drinks water, it dies. What is it?

riddle: एक थान म बत्तीस भाइ, एकै सँग रैन, झगड़ो नी करन।
roman: Ek thaan ma battees bhaai, ekai sang rain, jhagado nee karan.
english_translation: In one place thirty-two brothers live together without ever fighting. What are they?

riddle: कटोरिया म कटोरा, बेटा बाप है लै गोरा।
roman: Katoriya ma katora, beta baap hai lai gora.
english_translation: Bowl within a bowl, the son is even fairer than the father. What is it?

riddle: काली गैया बन मा चरै, दिन भर चरै, रात भर बंधै।
roman: Kaali gaiya ban ma charai, din bhar charai, raat bhar bandhai.
english_translation: A black cow grazes in the jungle; it grazes all day and is tied up all night. What is it?

riddle: उँच डांडा म सुक्यो रूख, न पाती न डाल।
roman: Unch daanda ma sukyo rookh, na paati na daal.
english_translation: On a high mountain peak stands a dry tree, having neither leaves nor branches. What is it?

riddle: बिना पाँवक हिंडै, बिना मुखक खाए, घोर अँध्यार म लै उज्याव करे।
roman: Bina paanvak hindai, bina mukhak khaaye, ghor andhyaar ma lai ujyaav kare.
english_translation: Walks without feet, consumes oil without a mouth, and brings light even into pitch darkness. What is it?

riddle: हरियो घाघर लाल पटुका, भीतर बैठी काली काकी।
roman: Hariyo ghaaghar laal patuka, bheetar baithee kaalee kaakee.
english_translation: Green skirt with a red shawl, inside sits an aunt with dark seeds. What is it?

riddle: एक नानतिन बटि सब डरान, घर म आवै त सब भागान।
roman: Ek naantin bati sab daraan, ghar ma aavai ta sab bhaagaan.
english_translation: Everyone fears this tiny creature, and whenever it enters the house, people rush to chase it out. What is it?

riddle: तीन आँखि छन पर शिव नी, पानी भर्यो छ पर घड़ो नी।
roman: Teen aankhi chhan par Shiv nee, paani bharyo chha par ghado nee.
english_translation: Has three eyes but is not Lord Shiva; contains water inside but is not an earthen pitcher. What is it?

riddle: एक रूख म बारहा डाली, हर डाली म तीस पाती।
roman: Ek rookh ma baaraha daali, har daali ma tees paati.
english_translation: One tree has twelve branches, and each branch bears thirty leaves. What is it?

riddle: बिन पाँवक धावै, बिन पंखक उडै, अगास म नाचै।
roman: Bin paanvak dhaavai, bin pankhak udai, agaas ma naachai.
english_translation: Runs without feet, flies without feathers, and dances across the high sky. What is it?

riddle: काळी गैया बन मा चरै, दिन भर चरै, रात भर बंधै।
roman: Kaali gaiya ban ma charai, din bhar charai, raat bhar bandhai.
english_translation: A dark beast grazes the forest all day and remains tied in the home at night. What is it?

riddle: दिनक सित रातक बिज।
roman: Dinak sit raatak bij.
english_translation: Sleeps through the daylight, awakens during the dark night.
hint: A flying nocturnal creature of the Himalayan caves
cultural_context: Found hanging in traditional stone eaves and hollow trees across Kumaon villages.

riddle: ऊँन हूँ ऊँनी छू ऊँनि लै नै देखि, जानि लै नै देखि।
roman: Oon hoon ooni chhoo ooni lai nai dekhi, jaani lai nai dekhi.
english_translation: It constantly arrives and departs, yet no one has ever seen it come or go.
hint: Universal human physical state of rest
cultural_context: Classic philosophical riddle told to children around the winter hearth (Angithi).

riddle: सिमारक हड़ सुक न सड़।
roman: Simaarak had suk na sad.
english_translation: A bodily organ that never dries up and never rots while alive.
hint: An organ in your mouth used for speaking and tasting
cultural_context: Celebrates the perpetual vitality and moistness of speech.

riddle: अखौलूनी का कीड़ खाछै कि, जाल मनि कीड़ा।
roman: Akhaulooni ka keed khaachhai ki, jaal mani keeda.
english_translation: Will you eat the creature in the mortar, or the insect beneath the comb net?
hint: Sweet golden nectar harvested from high mountain rock hives
cultural_context: Refers to traditional Himalayan Apis cerana beekeeping built into house walls (Jala).

riddle: अट्-पट् सट् सौ, तीनमुना दस पौ।
roman: At-pat sat sau, teenmuna das pau.
english_translation: Together they move: three heads and ten feet.
answer_kumaoni: बल्द और हलिया (दो बैल और हल चलाने वाला किसान)
answer_english: A team of two oxen and the ploughman (2 oxen + 1 farmer = 3 heads, 4+4+2 = 10 feet)
answer_hindi: बल्द और हलिया (दो बैल और हल चलाने वाला किसान)
hint: The essential agricultural scene on mountain terrace fields
cultural_context: Iconic terrace agriculture riddle celebrating the mountain ploughing season (Ropaai).

riddle: काव् भूतौक को सफेद गिच्च।
roman: Kaav bhootaunk ko safed gicch.
english_translation: A black ghost with a spotless white mouth.
answer_kumaoni: माँस को दाणो (उरद की दाल का दाना)
answer_english: Black gram seed (Black exterior with a white germ/scar)
answer_hindi: माँस को दाणो (उरद की दाल का दाना)
hint: A staple hill pulse grain used for making Dubke and Chainsu
cultural_context: Refers to local black gram (Urad / Maash) which is the cornerstone of Kumaoni winter nutrition.

riddle: एक बोट में बारै डाल, हर डाल में तीस-तीस पात।
roman: Ek bot mein baarai daal, har daal mein tees-tees paat.
english_translation: One tree has twelve branches, and each branch holds thirty leaves.
answer_kumaoni: साल, बारहो मैना और तीस दिन
answer_english: A year (1 tree), 12 months (12 branches), and 30 days (30 leaves)
answer_hindi: साल, बारहो मैना और तीस दिन
hint: How we measure the passing of time
cultural_context: Traditional calendar riddle taught to mountain children.

riddle: हरि-हरि बाखली, लाल-लाल द्वार, भीतर बैठी सुंदरी रानी।
roman: Hari-hari baakhli, laal-laal dwaar, bheetar baithi sundari raani.
english_translation: A green courtyard, bright red doorway, and a beautiful queen resting inside.
hint: A ruby-jewelled fruit of the Himalayan valleys
cultural_context: Wild Darim (Dadim) grows plentifully in Kumaon ravines and is prized for its tart seeds (Anardana).

riddle: एक रूख म तीन डाली, तीनू म एकै फल।
roman: Ek rookh ma teen daali, teenu ma ekai phal.
hindi: एक पेड़ में तीन डालियाँ, तीनों में एक ही फल (चूल्हा और तवा)।
english: One tree with three branches, and on all three rests a single fruit (Hearth/Stove and Griddle pan).
english_translation: One tree with three branches, and on all three rests a single fruit (Hearth/Stove and Griddle pan).

riddle: कालो बकरो वन म चरो, सींग नी दाँत नी लात म मरो।
roman: Kaalo bakro van ma charo, seeng ni daant ni laat ma maro.
hindi: काला बकरा जंगल में चरता है, सींग नहीं दाँत नहीं, लात से मरता है (जूँ)।
english: A black goat that grazes in the jungle, has no horns or teeth, dies under a stomp (Louse).
english_translation: A black goat that grazes in the jungle, has no horns or teeth, dies under a stomp (Louse).

riddle: लाल गाय लाकड़ खांछ, पाणि पिये त मरि जान्छ।
roman: Laal gaay laakad khaanch, paani piye ta mari jaanch.
hindi: लाल गाय लकड़ी खाती है, पानी पिए तो मर जाती है (आग)।
english: A red cow that eats wood, but if it drinks water it dies (Fire).
english_translation: A red cow that eats wood, but if it drinks water it dies (Fire).

riddle: नानतिन चेली पेट म दाँत।
roman: Naantin cheli pet ma daant.
hindi: छोटी सी लड़की, पेट में दाँत (दाँती / हँसिया)।
english: A little girl with teeth on her belly (Sickle).
english_translation: A little girl with teeth on her belly (Sickle).

riddle: दिन भरि हिंणो, रात भरि थकिबेर कोणा म बैठो।
roman: Din bhari hinano, raat bhari thakiber kona ma baitho.
hindi: दिन भर चलता है, रात को थककर कोने में बैठ जाता है (जूता)।
english: Walks all day, rests in a corner when tired at night (Shoe).
english_translation: Walks all day, rests in a corner when tired at night (Shoe).
